data.narrative:
Scout AI is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Colby Adcock and Collin Otis that has raised $15M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—all operating in Defense & Security at Seed or Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $15M total raised as a proxy for current value and applies a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier, yielding $38M. Peer-Median analysis examines four same-sector comparables spanning Seed and Series A: Stark Defence ($4.0B), UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M). The median valuation across this set is $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B, reflecting meaningful dispersion in the Defense & Security frontier-tech space.

Triangulation across both methods produces a valuation range of $32M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $369M. The wide range reflects structural uncertainty typical at the Seed stage: stage-progression anchors to early funding but assumes standard step-up dynamics, while peer-median captures significant heterogeneity in how Defense & Security investors price nascent companies. Key variables affecting valuation within this range include technology differentiation, customer traction, and regulatory pathway clarity.
